blocking_review.body:
PRELIMINARY REVIEW

BLOCKING REVIEW — exact head `7f2011472dbe18d8efdbdff015351c544b7142e0`.

The new `plasmon.ndeploy.json` entry points to `apps/review/review.v0.1.0.neutron`, but the same head packages Review as `review.v0.1.1.neutron`. The packaged demo CI consequently fails in `verifyDeploymentArchives` before the Playwright acceptance: `Required Plasmon deployment archive was not produced: apps/review/review.v0.1.0.neutron`. Update the manifest to the actual supported Review archive/version and rerun the packaged checks. The flake applicability job also fails because `test/ci/select-plasmon-flake-characterization.mjs` is missing on this head; that workflow/integration failure must be reconciled separately before the PR can be considered green.
